data.narrative:
Arena AI is a Series B-stage defense and security company that has raised $62M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 firms across Defense & Security—two public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private companies at matching or adjacent stages, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods yield materially divergent signals. The stage-progression method, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $62M raised proxy, implies a valuation of $118M. In contrast, the peer-median approach anchors to the median valuation of seven same-sector, same-stage comparables at $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The peer set exhibits substantial dispersion: Dream Security trades at $3.0B while Code Metal values at $1.2B, reflecting heterogeneity in execution, defensibility, and market traction within the cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $100M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $559M. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty about Arena AI's positioning relative to the peer cohort. Key variables driving valuation within this band include: differentiation of technology and IP relative to public and private competitors, revenue traction and customer concentration, and the strength of founding team execution (Ranade and Ural) in a capital-intensive, regulation-heavy sector. Resolution of these factors will determine whether Arena AI tracks toward the stage-progression floor or toward the peer median and above.
